_comment: Real, public legal documents for testing Agents 1-3 (data/legal/real/README.md says where each came from).
Each file in docs/ is an excerpt: the caption and the paragraphs with the facts, in the source's own words.
Page headers, footnotes, signature stamps and paragraphs of legal argument were left out; '...' marks a cut inside a paragraph.
must_hide: identifiers a person could be found by. The notebook reports each one still in Agent 3's safe text.
must_keep: the legal substance. The notebook reports each one Agent 3 dropped. Both are checked case-insensitively.
Neither list is a full gold annotation; they are spot checks a reader can verify by eye.
